Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home!  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

If there is one meal that belongs on your fall dinner table, it’s a cozy pot roast. Slow cooked until tender, served over creamy mashed potatoes and finished with a rich broth. It’s the ultimate comfort meal for fall 🍂 Full recipe down below, you can also find it in the link in my bio 🤎  Beef pot roast Ingredients: 	⁃	2-3 lb chuck roast 	⁃	1 medium white onion, sliced 	⁃	3 celery stalks, diced 	⁃	3 large carrots, sliced  	⁃	Bite size potatoes 	⁃	5 garlic cloves, minced 	⁃	Rosemary  	⁃	Thyme 	⁃	2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 	⁃	3 tbsp tomato paste 	⁃	2 Au jus gravy packets 	⁃	6 cups beef bone broth 	⁃	3 tbsp unsalted butter 	⁃	2 tbsp onion powder 	⁃	2 tbsp garlic powder 	⁃	Salt to taste Instructions: Wash and prep all of your vegetables. Peel and dice the carrots, slice the onion, mince the garlic, and dice the celery. Season the chuck roast to your liking. I used onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Make sure to season all sides of the roast. Add oil to a Dutch oven and sear the roast on all sides for 3–4 minutes per side. Remove the roast from the pot and set aside. Add the celery and onion to the pot and cook over medium heat until the onion has caramelized. Add the minced garlic last to prevent it from burning. Add the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, and gravy packets. Add ½ cup of beef broth to deglaze the pot, then pour in the remaining broth. Add the seasonings and taste to make sure everything is seasoned to your liking. Add the roast back to the pot, along with the carrots, potatoes, butter, and a bunch of rosemary and thyme tied together with butcher’s twine. Cover and place in a 350°F oven for 3 hours. About 30 minutes before the roast is finished, prepare the mashed potatoes. To assemble, add a bed of mashed potatoes to a plate, then top with the roast, potatoes, and carrots. Finish with some of the broth and fresh or dried parsley. Enjoy! 🤎 #fall #fallrecipes #potroast #cozyvibes #fallvibes

SLOPPY JOE BUNS RECIPE BELOW Ingredients DOUGH 250 ml lukewarm milk (1 cup) 15 g honey (1 tbsp) 7 g instant yeast (1 tbsp) 1 large egg 45 g unsalted butter, room temperature (3 tbsp, 1/2 stick) 500 g all-purpose flour (4 cups) 8 g fine salt (1⅓ tsp) SLOPPY JOE FILLING 25 ml olive oil (2 tbsp) 600 g ground beef (1⅓ lb) 4 g fine salt (⅔ tsp) 3 g paprika (1 tsp) 2 g garlic powder (⅔ tsp) 3 g onion powder (1 tsp) 3 g cayenne pepper (1 tsp) 1.5 g black pepper (½ tsp) 100 g ketchup (6 tbsps) EXTRA cheese slices (American or cheddar) Big Mac-style burger sauce 1 egg, beaten Sesame seeds Instructions Prepare all the ingredients. In a large bowl, combine the lukewarm milk, honey and yeast. Stir well and let the mixture rest for 5 minutes. Add the egg and butter and mix well. Add the flour and salt. Knead the dough for 10-12 minutes until smooth. Cover the bowl and let the dough rise in a warm spot for 1 hour, or until doubled in size. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef, salt, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne pepper and black pepper. Cook for 7-8 minutes, until browned and cooked through. Add the ketchup. Stir the ketchup into the beef until well combined. Let the filling cool completely before adding it to the dough. Deflate the risen dough and divide it into 9 equal pieces. Shape each piece into a ball. Roll each dough ball into a round sheet. Place a slice of cheese in the center of each disc, then top with some of the beef filling and a spoonful of burger sauce. Add extra cheese if you like. Fold the dough inwards and pinch it tightly closed. Place the buns seam side down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush with the beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Let rise for 30 minutes. Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C (400°F) for 12-18 minutes, or until golden brown. #food #sloppyjoe #beef #cheese #tiktokfood

Crockpot Mongolian Beef & Noodles 🥩🍜🔥 Crockpot Series Episode 7: Mongolian Beef & Noodles This is my crockpot series, where I help you make easy recipes so good you might find a spouse or impress the one you’ve got. Tender chuck roast, a sweet and savory Mongolian-style sauce, and noodles coated in all that flavor. We sear the beef for extra color, then the crockpot does the work and you take the credit! 🙌🏽🔥 Ingredients: 2 pounds thinly sliced chuck roast 4 tablespoons butter, for searing 1 cup low-sodium shoyu 1 cup brown sugar 1 cup low-sodium beef broth 2 tablespoons minced garlic 1 tablespoon grated ginger 2 tablespoon sesame oil 2 tablespoons rice vinegar 1 teaspoon black pepper 2 tablespoons cornstarch 2 tablespoons cold water 12 ounces precooked lo mein noodles. I used yakisoba noodles brand is Fortune. Sliced green onions Sesame seeds, optional Instructions: 1. Season your beef with SPG or your favorite seasoning. Heat a skillet over high heat with the butter and sear the beef in small batches for 1-2 minutes per side. You’re building color, not cooking it through. 2. Transfer the beef to the crockpot. Deglaze the skillet with a splash of the measured beef broth, scrape up those browned bits, and pour everything into the crockpot. 3. Add the remaining broth, shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and black pepper. Stir gently. 4. Cover and cook on LOW for 4 to 5 hours or HIGH for 2.5 to 3.5 hours. Start checking early so the thin beef stays tender without falling apart. 5. Mix the cornstarch slurry with a cup of broth. Stir the slurry into the sauce and cook on HIGH for 15–20 minutes, until thick and glossy. 6. Slice the green onions into 1 inch piece. Separate the precooked noodles and add them directly to the crockpot. Toss everything together and heat on HIGH for 5–10 minutes. 7. Finish with sliced green onions, sesame seeds, and chili crisp oil if you want some heat then serve immediately. Don’t leave those noodles sitting on KEEP WARM—they’ll keep drinking up the sauce. Save this one for an easy weeknight dinner! 🍜🔥 #crockpotrecipes #crockpot #EasyRecipe #hawaiitiktok #mongolianbeef

Crispy cheeseburger wraps Ingredients  For the beef mixture: 1 lb ground beef ( 80% lean, 20% fat ) 2 tbsp oil 1 yellow onion, finely diced  1 tbsp fresh garlic, minced 1 tbsp tomato paste Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  2 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp onion powder  1 large jalapeño, chopped 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce  1/2 cup water For the cheese burger sauce: 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp ketchup 1 tbsp yellow mustard 1/2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  1 1/2 tbsp finely minced dill pickles 1 tbsp pickle juice 1 tsp finely minced onion 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/4 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp sugar 1/4 tsp black pepper To assemble: 9 medium tortilla wraps 1 1/2 cup Mexican style four cheese  1/2 cup caramelized onions 1/3 cup picked jalapeños, chopped  Oil for pan frying  Method: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and cook 3–4 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned and fully cooked. Drain excess fat if needed, leaving a little behind. Add tomato paste, salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika and onion powder. Cook 1–2 minutes. Add Worcestershire sauce jalapeños and water. Simmer uncovered 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has completely reduced and the beef is moist but not watery. Taste and adjust salt if needed. Remove from heat and cool slightly. For the sauce, mix mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, pickles, pickle juice, onion, garlic powder, smoked paprika, sugar and black pepper until smooth. Refrigerate until ready to use. Lay out the tortillas and spread about 1 tbsp sauce slightly below the center. Add about 1/4 cup beef, 2 tbsp cheese, caramelized onions and pickled jalapeños. Fold the bottom over the filling, fold in the sides and roll tightly. Heat a thin layer of oil in a skillet over medium heat. Place wraps seam-side down and cook 2–3 minutes per side, pressing gently, until golden and crispy. Continue cooking until all sides are crisp and the cheese is melted. Rest 1–2 minutes, slice in half and serve immediately with extra cheeseburger sauce.  #recipe #cheeseburger

Fruity Pebble Ice Cream Taco #shorts #food #recipe Full Recipe 👇🏿 Fruity Pebbles Choco Tacos Yield: 6–8 tacos TOOLS NEEDED Mixing bowls Fine mesh strainer Electric hand mixer Rubber spatula Waffle cone maker Taco shell holder Pastry brush Microwave-safe bowl Ice cream scoop or piping bag --- BEFORE YOU START - Keep the heavy cream very cold and stop whipping just under stiff peaks so the ice cream stays light and creamy. - Shape the waffle taco shells immediately while they are still hot. Once they cool, they will crack instead of bending. - Let the taco shells cool completely before adding the white chocolate, and keep them upright in a taco holder anytime they are setting or freezing. --- FRUITY PEBBLES ICE CREAM Ingredients 2 cups cold heavy whipping cream, divided 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles cereal, for soaking 3/4 cup sweetened condensed milk 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, finely chopped 2 tablespoons caramel sauce Instructions 1. Add 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles to a bowl and pour about 1 1/2 cups of the heavy cream over the cereal. 2. Cover and refrigerate for 2–3 hours. 3. Pour the cereal and cream through a fine mesh strainer into a clean bowl. 4. Press down firmly on the soaked cereal with the back of a spoon or spatula to get as much of the Fruity Pebbles cream out as possible. 5. Discard the soaked cereal. 6. Add enough fresh cold heavy cream to the strained cream to bring it back up to about 2 cups total. 7. Whip the cream until it reaches just under stiff peaks. It should be thick and fluffy but still smooth. 8. Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk. 9. Finely chop or crush 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles. 10. Mix the cereal with the caramel sauce. 11. Fold the caramel Fruity Pebbles mixture into the ice cream. 12. Transfer to a freezer-safe container, cover, and freeze for 4–6 hours or until firm enough to scoop. --- WAFFLE TACO SHELLS Ingredients Prepared homemade waffle cone batter Instructions 1. Preheat your waffle cone maker. 2. Add enough batter to make a thin, even waffle and cook until golden brown. 3. As soon as it comes off the waffle cone maker, carefully fold it into a taco shape. 4. MEATBALL SUB BITES! Homemade meatballs tossed in pizza sauce, then wrapped up in pizza dough with mozzarella and baked until golden brown, then brushed with butter, parm & parsley. And warm pizza sauce for dipping. It’s game day season and these are the perfect 2-bite app that we’re 100% sure everyone will love!!  Full recipe at: https://www.crowdedkitchen.com/meatball-sub-bites/ 1 lb 80/20 ground beef ½ cup Italian-seasoned breadcrumbs ½ cup whole milk 1 large egg ⅓ cup grated parmesan cheese 2 garlic cloves grated ¾ teaspoon kosher salt ½ teaspoon black pepper 8 ounces pizza dough 12 ounces pizza sauce divided ½ cup low-moisture mozzarella shredded 2 tablespoons melted butter for brushing Grated parmesan for topping Chopped parsley for topping Preheat your oven to 425˚F. To a small mixing bowl, add the breadcrumbs and milk together, stir, and let the mixture rest for five minutes. It should look like thick oatmeal, so add milk a tablespoon at a time if it looks dry. To a large mixing bowl, add the ground beef, panade, egg, parmesan, garlic, salt, and pepper. Mix gently by hand just until combined. Using a 3 tablespoon scoop, scoop into 14 meatballs and roll them into shape. Bake the meatballs 425°F for about 15 minutes. Slightly underbaked is fine; they'll be going back into the oven later. Toss the meatballs in about 4 ounces of the pizza sauce, setting the other half of the sauce aside for dipping later. They should be coated, not drenched. Cut the dough. Roll to ~12×10" and cut into squares. Grease a muffin tin. To make one of the meatball sub bites, add a square of pizza dough into one of the muffin slots, then place a pinch of shredded mozzarella on the bottom, a saucy meatball on top, and a pinch more mozzarella over it. Gather the corners over the top of the meatball, one at a time. Bake at 400°F for about 18-20 minutes, until deep golden and 160°F+ in the center. Brush with butter and parmesan before serving.

The BEST carrot cake you’ll ever make! 🥕🍰 My Grandma Peggy’s Outrageous Carrot Cake is no ordinary carrot cake—it’s packed with carrots, pineapple, coconut + walnuts, then soaked in a browned-butter buttermilk glaze and finished with the silkiest cream cheese frosting! Save this recipe—and sign up to get my recipes in your email (link in bio!) INGREDIENTS: CAKE: 2¾ cups AP flour, 3 tsp baking soda, 2½ tsp cinnamon, ½ tsp ginger, ¼ tsp nutmeg, ¾ tsp kosher salt, 5 large eggs (room temp), 3 cups sugar, 1 cup + 2 Tbsp vegetable oil, 1 cup + 2 Tbsp buttermilk (room temp), 1 Tbsp orange zest, 3 tsp vanilla, 2½ cups grated carrots, 12 oz crushed pineapple (drained), 2 cups sweetened flaked coconut, 1½ cups chopped walnuts GLAZE: ¾ cup salted butter, 1¼ cups sugar, ¾ cup buttermilk, 2 Tbsp honey, 1½ tsp baking soda FROSTING: 1 cup salted butter (room temp), 22 oz cream cheese (room temp), 3 tsp vanilla, 8 cups confectioners’ sugar (sifted) DIRECTIONS: Heat oven to 350°F. Grease three 8-inch cake pans; line bottoms with parchment and grease again. Sift flour, baking soda, spices + salt. Beat eggs, sugar, oil, buttermilk, zest + vanilla until smooth. On low, gradually add dry ingredients just until combined. Fold in carrots, pineapple, coconut + walnuts. Divide among pans. Bake 35-45 min, rotating halfway, until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool in pans 10 min; turn onto racks set over a baking sheet. Glaze: Melt butter over medium heat until golden brown + nutty. Reduce heat; carefully stir in sugar, buttermilk, honey + baking soda. Bring to a boil over medium-high; cook, stirring often, until deep caramel color. Evenly pour over warm cakes; cool completely. Frosting: Beat butter + cream cheese until smooth, about 3 min. Beat in vanilla. With mixer off, add sugar ½ cup at a time, mixing on low after each addition. Beat medium-high 30 sec. Evenly frost each layer, then insert skewers to secure. Refrigerate 30 min. Apply final coat, remove skewers, then smooth over holes. Garnish with coconut + walnuts. #carrotcake #cakerecipe #baking #dessert #thebuckheadbaker

This is my new favourite high-protein comfort meal 🤤 Think chukauni… but with juicy golden chicken, smoky mustard oil tadka, garlic-y curd, and those Nepali-style flavours that just hit different. It’s rich, tangy, spicy, creamy — and honestly perfect with soft rotis or steaming hot rice. Nepali Style Chicken Chukauni  🥣 Serves: 3 🔥 Macros (per serving): Calories: 374 kcal | Protein: 38 g | Carbs: 2.7 g | Fat: 22.3 g Ingredients For the Chicken 	•	400 g boneless chicken thigh (or breast), cut into small cubes 	•	2 tsp ginger-garlic paste 	•	½ tsp salt 	•	½ tsp pepper 	•	1 tsp Kashmiri chili powder 	•	½ tsp turmeric powder 	•	1 tsp lemon juice 	•	Light brush or spray of oil for frying For the Mix 	•	1 small onion, thinly sliced 	•	1–2 green chilies, chopped 	•	3 tbsp fresh coriander leaves, chopped (divided) For the Yogurt Base 	•	1 cup thick curd (I used Amul High-Protein Curd) or Greek yogurt  	•	1 tsp garlic paste 	•	½ tsp salt 	•	½ tsp sugar For the Tadka 	•	1.5 tbsp mustard oil 	•	½ tsp turmeric powder 	•	1 tsp Kashmiri chili powder 	•	1 tsp kasuri methi, crushed Method 1️⃣ Mix chicken with ginger-garlic paste, salt, pepper, Kashmiri chili powder, turmeric, and lemon juice. Rest 10–15 minutes. 2️⃣ Brush or spray a pan with very little oil. Pan-fry chicken on medium-high until golden brown. Transfer to a bowl. 3️⃣ Add sliced onion, chopped chilies, and half the coriander. Mix well and set aside. 4️⃣ In another bowl, whisk thick curd with garlic paste, salt, and sugar until smooth and creamy. 5️⃣ Heat mustard oil until smoking hot. Turn off the heat, add turmeric, Kashmiri chili powder, and crushed kasuri methi. 6️⃣ Pour the hot tadka into the curd and swirl gently to keep the streaks. 7️⃣ Pour the yogurt mixture over the chicken mixture. Mix gently. Finish with more chopped coriander leaves. Enjoy with soft rotis or steaming hot rice. . Recipe Name Creamy Garlic Shrimp Stuffed Shells Ingredients 1. 20 jumbo pasta shells 2. 1 lb large shrimp, peeled, deveined, and chopped 3. 2 tbsp butter 4. 4 cloves garlic, minced 5. 1 cup ricotta cheese 6. 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese 7. 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 8. 1 large egg 9. 1 1/2 cups heavy cream 10. 2 tbsp cream cheese 11. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp salt 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped 16. 1 tbsp lemon juice 17. 1 tbsp olive oil Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). 2. Cook the jumbo pasta shells in salted boiling water until al dente. 3. Drain the shells and rinse them with cool water so they do not continue cooking. 4. Heat olive oil and butter in a skillet over medium heat. 5. Add the shrimp and cook for about 2 minutes per side until pink and nearly cooked through. 6. Add half of the minced garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper. 7. Cook for another 30–60 seconds, then remove the shrimp from the heat. 8. Chop the shrimp into smaller pieces and allow it to cool slightly. 9. In a large bowl, combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, 1/2 cup mozzarella, Italian seasoning, and fresh parsley. 10. Fold the cooked shrimp into the cheese mixture until evenly distributed. 11. Melt the cream cheese into the heavy cream in a saucepan over medium-low heat. 12. Add the remaining minced garlic and stir until the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. 13. Stir in the lemon juice and a small pinch of salt and black pepper. 14. Spread a thin layer of the creamy garlic sauce across the bottom of a baking dish. 15. Fill each pasta shell generously with the shrimp and cheese mixture. 16. Arrange the stuffed shells in the dish and pour the remaining Alfredo sauce over and around them. 17. Sprinkle the remaining mozzarella and Parmesan over the top. 18. Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes. 19. Remove the foil and bake for another 8–10 minutes until the cheese is melted, bubbling, and lightly golden. 20. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot with extra creamy sauce spooned over the shells. Follow this account for more creamy, cheesy recipes that taste like restaurant favorites at home.

Creamy Garlic Herb Slow Cooker Beef Roast Ingredients 1. Beef chuck roast – 4 lb 2. Yellow onion – 1 large, sliced 3. Garlic – 7 cloves, minced 4. Olive oil – 2 tbsp 5. Unsalted butter – 3 tbsp 6. Beef broth – 1 1/2 cups 7. Heavy cream – 1 cup 8. Cream cheese – 4 oz, softened 9. Parmesan cheese – 1/2 cup, finely grated 10. Worcestershire sauce – 1 tbsp 11. Dijon mustard – 1 tbsp 12. Dried Italian seasoning – 2 tsp 13. Dried thyme – 1 tsp 14. Garlic powder – 1 tsp 15. Black pepper – 1 tsp 16. Kosher salt – 1 1/2 tsp 17. Red pepper flakes – 1/4 tsp 18. Fresh parsley – 2 tbsp, chopped Recipe 1. Pat the beef roast completely dry with paper towels. Season all sides generously with kosher salt, black pepper, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, and dried thyme. 2. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the seasoned roast and sear for 3 to 4 minutes per side until a dark golden-brown crust forms. 3. Transfer the browned roast to a slow cooker. Scatter the sliced onion and half of the minced garlic around the beef. 4. Melt the butter in the same skillet over medium heat. Add the remaining garlic and cook for 30 to 45 seconds until fragrant, taking care not to let it burn. 5. Add the beef broth, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, and red pepper flakes to the skillet. Stir thoroughly while scraping the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the seasoned broth over the roast and onions. Cover the slow cooker and cook on LOW for 8 to 9 hours until the beef is tender enough to pull apart easily. 7. About 30 minutes before serving, carefully remove the roast and keep it covered on a plate. Leave the hot cooking juices and onions inside the slow cooker. 8. Whisk the softened cream cheese and heavy cream together in a bowl until smooth. Slowly stir in the Parmesan cheese to create a thick creamy mixture. 9. Add the cream mixture to the hot cooking juices in the slow cooker and stir thoroughly until the sauce becomes smooth, creamy, and well blended with the beef drippings. 10. Return the roast to the slow cooker and spoon the creamy garlic herb sauce generously over the top. Cover and cook on HIGH for 20 to 30 minutes to allow the sauce to thicken and the beef to absorb the flavors. 11. Carefully turn the roast once or twice while coating it with the sauce, keeping the meat intact and tender rather than shredding it completely. 12. Spoon additional creamy sauce over the roast and allow it to pool around the meat. Check the seasoning and add a small amount of salt or black pepper if needed. 13. Sprinkle the finished roast generously with fresh chopped parsley for a bright herb garnish. 14. Serve the tender beef in large portions with the creamy garlic sauce spooned over each serving, alongside mashed potatoes, steamed vegetables, or warm dinner rolls.
